components.A: Actual official PE5year: PE<60 AND close>MA120 enter; PE>=30 AND close<=MA120 exit.
components.B: Frozen equal-PB10year: PB<10 AND close>MA120 enter; PB>=60 AND close<=MA120 exit.
components.C: Frozen equal-PB5year pure value: PB<10 enter; PB>=60 exit.

signals: Combine current raw entry/exit predicates, NOT independent strategy historical position bits. Each combination owns state. Same-day AND exits require all current exit predicates, no remembered confirmations.
state: Valid data: exit dominates. If chosen exit predicate true, remain/go flat; otherwise if flat and chosen entry true, enter. Otherwise hold state. Can reenter when conditions recover; no cooldown or special stop. Missing needed valuation: retain state.
startup: Each continuous account starts next session after250-price-day warmup and complete valuation history for all used inputs. PB10 combinations start2017-01-04; PE+PB5 start2014-03-31. Near10year unavailable if no anchor equity; never backfill invalid years with cash.
execution: 100000 initial, next open, lot100, slippage10bp each leg, commission1bp min5, cash yield0, no allocation cap/inflows, end marked not liquidated.
train: Structure comparison only:2017-01-04 to2020-12-31 common fresh100000 accounts, indicators/state use prehistory. Select highest training annual, then smaller maxDD, fewer components, lexical id. All thresholds fixed. Write selection before running holdout.
holdout: 2020-12-31 close to2026-10-30; history previously seen, retrospective pseudo-OOS only. Rank recent5year outcomes diagnostic, never reselect structure from holdout.
sensitivity: For each structure perturb ONLY parameters actually used, one-at-time +/-5pp, plus two all-active-parameter +/-5pp scenarios. Do not select best neighbor. Recompute perturbed standalone references too. Report scenario count and unique paths; no full high-dimensional robustness claim.
increment: Compare each combined account with BOTH standalone components replayed from same valid inception and cost. Also retain original standalone continuous portfolios. Annual differences<=0.05pp treated as numerical ties, not meaningful alpha. Three-way compared to all3 components.
acceptance: Frozen training-selected structure needs recent3/recent5/holdout annual greater than every matched standalone by0.05pp, recent5 maxDD no larger than best-annual standalone by0.05pp, and majority of parameter scenarios retain positive recent5 increment. Record failures; no retuning.
